leo-finops: Heads up  new contractor (Vilma Dev) invoiced this morning from Estonia and asked if Redwood can gross-up for local income tax. Invoice shows an EST VAT ID and line items for dev hours. Are we withholding anything, and do we charge VAT?

vilma-dev: Hi! I'm invoicing from my Estonian sole prop. Invoice attached. I included my VAT number EE123456789 and I'd like Redwood to gross-up so the net I receive equals my quoted rate after Estonian social/tax. Can you confirm process?

marta-ops: Quick context  Vilma has been hired on a 3-month retainer for infra work, treated as an independent contractor. We set up a PO and asked for invoice for payment run.

nina-tax: Quick answers: 1) VAT: since you're an EU supplier and Redwood (buyer) is a business with a valid VAT ID, this is B2B and reverse charge normally applies  we won't pay Estonian VAT if your VAT ID validates via VIES and we can evidence B2B. 2) Withholding: generally for cross-border B2B services EU-to-US there isn't a US withholding. Local Estonian income tax is the supplier's responsibility. We (Redwood) don't withhold Estonian income tax for contractor invoices.

leo-finops: So if we don't withhold, can we still agree to a gross-up as a commercial concession?

nina-tax: That's a commercial negotiation, not a tax requirement. If Finance/Legal agree to gross-up, it's a compensation change: Redwood pays a higher gross amount so contractor nets the agreed amount after taxes. But we need approvals because it affects budget and tax reporting. Also document the rationale.

legal-bot: Flag: if we agree to gross-up, update the SOW and payment terms. Also confirm contractor classification remains independent (no payroll reclassification).

acct-pay: Practical: to process without VAT we need: vendor VAT ID, copy of invoice showing VAT line (or absence), and a VIES validation screenshot. If gross-up approved, indicate new PO amount and reason code in FIN system.

vilma-dev: I can provide VIES screenshot and a W-8/W-9? I'm an Estonian resident, non-US, so W-8BEN maybe?

nina-tax: Correct, non-US person -> W-8BEN (individual). But W-8 is for US tax withholding purposes; we typically request it for our records. For EU reverse-charge, the VIES VAT validation is primary. If you have an Estonian tax residency cert (or other TRC), not required for B2B VAT but helpful if any future withholding discussions arise.

leo-finops: Next steps proposed: 1) Ask Vilma for VIES validation screenshot + signed W-8BEN. 2) Finance to decide on gross-up ask (needs budget owner signoff). 3) If approved, Legal to update SOW and Acct-Pay to update PO/invoice.

marta-ops: Budget owner is product@redwood, pinging them for signoff.

ledger-bot: Invoice recorded: INV-2026-0456 for vendor VILMA-EST. Payment run scheduled 2026-02-20. Link: https://billing.redwood/invoices/INV-2026-0456

leo-finops: Example invoice preview for accounting:

```
- services: 5,000.00 EUR
- VAT (0% reverse charge): 0.00 EUR
- total: 5,000.00 EUR
```

If gross-up were approved (example target net 5,000 EUR, estimated local tax 20%), we'd increase gross to ~6,250 EUR so net after 20% = 5,000 EUR.

acct-pay: Note: if we pay grossed-up amount we need a cost center override and tax memo. Create ticket FIN-4899 with required fields: vendor VAT ID, W-8BEN, VIES screenshot, gross-up calculation, budget approval, legal signoff.

vilma-dev: Thanks  I'll upload VIES screenshot and signed W-8BEN to the vendor portal now. I prefer a reissued PO if gross-up approved.

nina-tax: Sounds good. One more reminder: keep the invoice narrative clear: "Reverse charge  customer liable" and include your VAT ID on invoice. That keeps auditors happy.

leo-finops: I'll wait for product budget signoff then circle back. No tax withholding from our side unless local law says otherwise and we get a formal request.

marta-ops: Product budget owner approved provisional gross-up subject to Legal SOW change.

legal-bot: I'll draft amendment template and post in #contracts for signature.

acct-pay: Ticket FIN-4899 created. Will pick up once attachments are in vendor portal.

leo-finops: Thanks all. Closing thread once FIN-4899 moves to 'ready to pay'.
